{{Quote|It's an Alliance signal receiver. When the light starts blinking, it means we're close to a broadcasting base-homing device.|A Rebel operative in the Roche asteroid field|<ref name="SFS" />}}
A '''signal receiver''' was a communication device capable of receiving signals from [[base-homing device]]s. The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] used signal receivers aboard their [[Starship/Legends|starships]] to locate hidden bases.<ref name="SFS" />
